    How it works

    Chord-only lines attach to the lyric line immediately below them. Spacing determines chord placement, including changes inside a word. Use the word-start option if that better matches your sheet. Section headings and blank lines stay in place. Standalone instrumental chords are kept.

    For broken web copies, choose Broken web copy. Chord lines become inline chords, lyric fragments join with their existing spaces, and blank lines separate passages. Check word spacing and add line breaks where needed.

    Paste from a monospaced source when possible. If copied spacing is lost, check the result before using it. For the music editor, paste one section’s converted lyrics into its lyrics-and-chords field; enter the section name separately.

    Everything runs in this browser. Text is not uploaded or saved; copy it before closing or refreshing.
